extends Node
var p
func _ready() -> void:
	p = get_meta("viento_project")
	set_process(false)
	set_physics_process(false)
	p.host.get_ref().flushing = true
	_published("empty", p.publish_event("empty", 1))
	first_token = p.subscribe_event("fanout", _first)
	removed_token = p.subscribe_event("fanout", _removed)
	last_token = p.subscribe_event("fanout", _last)
	_published("fanout", p.publish_event("fanout", 2))
	call_deferred("_start")
func _start() -> void:
	var host = p.host.get_ref()
	host.set_process(false)
	host.flushing = false
	host.flush_requests()
	_probe("drain", "ready-batch")
	call_deferred("_finish")
func _probe(kind: String, label: String, extra: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
	var data := {"kind": kind, "label": label, "clock": {"idleFrame": Engine.get_process_frames(), "physicsFrame": Engine.get_physics_frames()}}
	data.merge(extra)
	print("VIENTO_EVENT_POSITION_PROBE:" + JSON.stringify(data))
func _published(label: String, accepted: bool) -> void:
	_probe("published", label, {"accepted": accepted, "sequence": p.host.get_ref().event_bus.sequence})
func _delivered(label: String, sequence: int, subscription_id: int) -> void:
	_probe("delivered", label, {"sequence": sequence, "subscriptionId": subscription_id})
func _finish() -> void:
	p.host.get_ref().finish_project()
var first_token := 0
var removed_token := 0
var last_token := 0
func _first(value) -> bool:
	if not p.unsubscribe_event(removed_token):
		return false
	_delivered("first", int(value), first_token)
	return true
func _removed(_value) -> bool:
	_probe("unexpected", "removed-called")
	return false
func _last(value) -> bool:
	_delivered("last", int(value), last_token)
	return true
